name: Should I repair my old deck or build a new one?
description: Consider repair if the foundation and structure are sound; opt for new if damage is widespread or you desire a major design change.

mainEntity.name: Should I repair my old deck or build a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repairing an existing deck and building a new one depends on several factors, primarily the age and condition of the current structure. If the deck's foundation and most of its structural components are sound, repair is often a more cost-effective option. However, if there is widespread rot, significant structural damage, or if you desire a complete design change or different materials, a new deck might be a better long-term investment. We can assess your deck's integrity and discuss the pros and cons of each option to help you make an informed decision for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider repair if the foundation and structure are sound; opt for new if damage is widespread or you desire a major design change.
